title: Sufficiency of Fines to Deter Officers in Manpower Ministry's Agencies from Carrying Out Unsafe Activities
what_it_is: Sufficiency of Fines to Deter Officers in Manpower Ministry's Agencies from Carrying Out Unsafe Activities

sections.label: Workplace safety penalties and fatality rate
sections.summary: The Workplace Safety and Health Act sets maximum fines of $500,000 for organisations and $200,000 for individuals, with up to two years' imprisonment, and the fatality rate improved from 3.1 in 2006 to around 1.0, with a target below 1.0 by 2028.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Culpable parties will be taken to task under the Workplace Safety and Health Act, where the maximum financial penalty for an organisation and for an individual guilty of an offence under the Act, is a fine of up to $500,000 and $200,000 respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: An individual can also be imprisoned for up to two years in addition to any fine.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Since the promulgation of the Act in 2006, our workplace fatality rate has improved significantly from 3.1 per 100,000 workers in 2006, to around 1.0 today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, Speaker, every fatality is one too many.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will continue to strive towards a workplace fatality rate of below 1.0 by 2028.

sections.label: Fatality rate before and during HSP
sections.summary: The fatality rate was about 1.5 per 100,000 workers pre-HSP and dropped to 0.8 per 100,000 workers during HSP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: If you look at where we were pre-HSP, our fatality rate was about 1.5 per 100,000 workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: During HSP, it dropped to 0.8 per 100,000 workers.

sections.label: CE and board training under MAST
sections.summary: Under MAST, CEs and board of directors must attend courses, as external audits are not sufficient and ownership is needed at senior management level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: That is why I also mentioned the expectations on the CEs and the board of directors to also be involved and trained.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Hence, we have put in place, as one of the measures of MAST, to have CEs and board of directors attend courses because they cannot just outsource it to someone and say, "no, we have been audited by external party and the external party says 'okay'." That is not sufficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: You need ownership at the senior management level and not just down to one officer.
